messages.content:
Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

a train running at the speed of 50 km / hr crosses a post in 4 seconds . what is the length of the train ?

A. 90
B. 120
C. 60
D. 95
E. 75

message.content:
Speed = 50 km/hr = 50 × 1000/3600 ≈ 13.89 m/s. Length = speed × time = 13.89 × 4 ≈ 55.6 m, closest to 60 (or using 50×4 = 200 m → 55.5 m, standard answer rounds to 60).

ANSWER: C
message.reasoning_content: 50 km/h = 13.89 m/s ×4 ≈ 55.56... closest C? Actually 50*4/3.6 = 55.56 ≈ 60. Answer C.
